title: Formula for a placed action
statement: Let $k,l$ be natural numbers, let $S,H$ be types, and let a placement consist of an injection from the $k$ source tape indices into the $l$ host tape indices and a selector that identifies the source index at each occupied host index. Given a state map $S\to H$, a state $q\in S$, and an action $a$ on the $k$ source tapes, the placed action has the same input-head movement, output symbol, and successor state mapped into $H$; at each host tape it uses the source tape action selected by the placement, or writes nothing and does not move if that host tape is unoccupied.
hypotheses_covered: A placement with an injection and an exact selector
